If $Z∼N(0,1),$ then by the definition of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z),$ 

$$
P(Z\le z)=Φ(z).
$$

Also, since $Z$ is continuous, 

$$
P(Z<0.75)=P(Z\le 0.75)=Φ(0.75).
$$

The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069404/assets/2541e696df1d871e65d3717d03c2ce842f4312c6a86fd09ccc8f13e04d8d1216.png)

Now, we determine the value of $Φ(0.75)$ from the table:

- We first select the row that corresponds to $0.7$ and the column that corresponds to $0.05.$

- Then, we take the value that lies at the intersection:

| $z$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ | $\,0.05\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,0.5\,$ | $\,0.7019\,$ | $\,0.7054\,$ | $\,0.7088\,$ |
| $\,0.6\,$ | $\,0.7357\,$ | $\,0.7389\,$ | $\,0.7422\,$ |
| $\,0.7\,$ | $\,0.7673\,$ | $\,0.7704\,$ | $\,0.7734\,$ |

Therefore, according to the table, we have

$$
P(Z\le 0.75)=Φ(0.75)=0.7734.
$$
